prose: Heathen Wizard and Odin's favorite Alchemist, Benjamin Balderson, returns to InnerVerse! This chat begins with updates on Ben's lab situation, and then we get into the magic of hydrogen, the metaphor of Odin merging the Aesir and Vanir, shifting from duality mind to a four elements approach, and the zodiacal man.
ext: We go further with the electric/galvanic universe evidence, the wandering stars and how they play into the battery concept, Ragnarok and the "hard charge" in our system, and a new take on the World Tree / Cosmic Egg cosmology.
links: Benjamin Balderson's last appearance on InnerVerse
